titulo_es: Use - for a future condition or moment

ついたら.en: when it comes; if it comes

bloques.titulo: It has a condition and can also introduce what will be done when something happens.
texto: The form is short past + ∞: It does not mean that action has happened; the context can speak of a future possibility.
(When you get to the station, let me know.)

frases.ja: あめ が ふったら、 うち に います。
frases.es: Si llueve, me quedaré en casa.
frases.en: If it rains, I'll stay home.

frases.ja: えき に ついたら、 れんらく して ください。
frases.es: Cuando llegues a la estación, avísame.
frases.en: When you get to the station, let me know.
